janet: heads-up: deploybot failed to push redwood/ingest:2026-03-21 -> europe-west2 (GCR). Attestation key id mismatch on verify. can someone triage?

janet: ```
[2026-03-21T14:45:12Z] publish: redwood/ingest:2026-03-21 -> europe-west2
error: attestation verify: SIGNATURE_MISMATCH (expected 0x9f7a got 0x7c1d)
deploybot: publish aborted
```

deploybot: automated: publish failed for `redwood/ingest:2026-03-21` (attempt 1). see job 99344.

ram: infra rotated cosign keys last night. verifier agents in eu haven't picked up new trust bundle yet.

infra-bot: verifier sync job failing on eu nodes: upstream truststore 403 while fetching key metadata. KMS lookup blocked; ops paging KMS. ETA ~30-50m.

compliance: we cannot bypass attestation for EU-regulated customers. manual republish is allowed if labeled/audited.

ram: plan: retag last-known-good digest as `2026-03-21-eu-republish`, include labels `manual_republish=true,manual_republisher=ram,manual_republish_reason=attest-key-rotation`, open PR with audit ticket. will hold canary in eu.

release-manager: set `region_skip=europe-west2` for canary. if verifier not healthy in 2h, rollback EU to 2026-03-11.

sre-ops: standby for smoke after republish: `smoke/regression --region europe-west2 --image sha256:feedface`.

ram: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4305. pushing retag now.

deploybot: automated: pausing further publishes to europe-west2 for this release. other regions unaffected.

ram: push complete: redwood/ingest:2026-03-21-eu-republish -> sha256:feedface. labels set. linked audit ticket #AUD-4518 in PR.

sre-ops: smoke running, initial checks look OK. will report any anomalies.

infra-bot: KMS team resolved access error; verifier sync healthy now. recommend re-run attestation verify against original image once systems fully reconciled.

compliance: will review audit ticket and PR. thanks for labels and the trace.

release-manager: keeping canary paused until SRE green. logging this thread id `gcr-eu-repub-3170009123`. close once verifier + original attestation reconciled or rollback executed.
